CLOSED SESSION (5:30 p.m.)

This time has been set aside for the City Council to meet in a closed session to discuss the
matter listed below pursuant to Government Code § 54956(b), which was continued from the
Regular Meeting of June 26, 2012. The Mayor or City Attorney will give an additional oral
report regarding the closed session.

    CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Pursuant to Government Code § 54956(b)

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING
July 2, 2012
  1
   Number of potential cases: 3
  Potential claims arising from Bluff Cove Homes licenses and current uses

At the conclusion of the Closed Session, the Council may continue any item listed on the closed
session to the Open Session agenda for discussion or to take formal action as it may deem
appropriate.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT
on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters
presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be
referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.

ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, JULY 10, 2012, IN COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY
HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
